name: Bernard L. Madoff (illustrated representation, 2000-2009)
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness. A generic white-haired man in his late sixties in a dark business suit, white shirt and plain tie: no photo reference, no famous image recreated (no courthouse-steps photo, no mugshot). Never shown handling cash or with any victim; never posed heroically; none of his words are quoted except the reported 'one big lie' on a 'WORDING AS REPORTED' card. Every shot he is in is tagged 'ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS'. Closed case: pleaded guilty 12 Mar 2009, sentenced to 150 years 29 Jun 2009, died in prison 14 Apr 2021.
rules: Shown only in his office, at home (with his sons as anonymous silhouettes), at his door at the arrest, in court. No cash, no victims.
